lines: Speak every customer’s language. It’s easy to translate and adapt your store content for any market.
Use translations by Shopify for up to 2 languages.
Adapt content to reflect spelling and messaging variations between markets.
Localize directly from the theme editor, or any resource page in your admin.

Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, and Vietnamese
